val [events](events.html): [MutableList](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin.collections/-mutable-list/index.html)<[Event](../../com.google.adk.kt.events/-event/index.html)>

The events of the session, e.g. user input, model response, function call/response, etc. Defaults to a concurrent list so that appending an event (e.g. from one parallel branch) while another reads the history does not throw `ConcurrentModificationException`.

fun [toBuilder](to-builder.html)(): [Session.Builder](-builder/index.html)

Returns a [Builder](-builder/index.html) initialized with this instance's properties, primarily for Java callers. Prefer it over `copy` from Java: `copy` takes every property positionally, so its signature changes whenever a property is added. The event list is copied, but [state](../../../google-adk-kotlin-core/com.google.adk.kt.sessions/-session/--root--.html) is shared with this instance.
